rv.q: As an inveterate joiner-inner, I loved the experience; I also wondered whether those who chose simply to observe would feel well enough served by a narrative that never quite allows the characters enough time or depth.
This authentically Scottish show is riding a wave of hype following its runs in America and at Pitlochry - and it well and truly lives up to it.
But even for the totally uninitiated, it’s just a straightforwardly fun night out that feels both life-affirming and quietly anti-zeitgeist.
To quibble with semantics too much would be majoring on the minor, in a show that provides a party atmosphere to which any and all are welcome.
Joyful, moving, funny and utterly life-affirming, Ceilidh is one of the most original and heartwarming theatrical experiences in London this year.
I have rarely seen anything on stage quite as joyous as this.
Overall, Ceilidh The Musical , is a thoroughly feel-good night out!
Ceilidh The Musical is exactly as the name suggests; a magical combination of the traditional Scottish gathering with the addition of songs and a story.
Ceilidh deserves ten stars out of five.
So drink deeply of this Scottish spirit, because it tastes joyous, hilarious and heartachingly wonderful.

cn.t: Critics praise this innovative immersive musical for brilliantly blending traditional Scottish ceilidh dancing with storytelling, creating a joyful, unique theatrical experience that gets audiences on their feet.
